Cold and Flu Sweet Remedy

Time:
Servings:
Source
Tags:

Ingredients

  • 1 Cup of sugar
  • 1/2 Cup of water
  • 1 Tablespoon of lemon juice
  • 1 Tablespoon of honey
  • 1/2 Teaspoon of ground ginger
  • 1/4 Teaspoon of ground cloves

Instructions

Mix everyting in a saucepan and bring to boil.
Let simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring regularly.
Line a baking tray with baking paper. When the mixture is syrupy and thicker, let it cool and pour drops of the size of a coin on the baking paper.
Let the drops cool for 20 minutes and dust them with confectioner or dusting sugar.
